messages.text: Are all globes geographically current?   Are Gulf of Mexico and Lake Ontario properly identified?

Good question. Our globes reflect the cartography and political boundaries current at the time each globe was manufactured, so standard geographic features like the Gulf of Mexico and Lake Ontario are labelled with their standard names. I don't have a line-by-line spec confirming exact wording for every globe model, so if you want to double check a specific model before buying, reach out to (email hidden) and they can confirm.

You've been looking at a few 16" floor globes — the Lafayette, the Cambridge (French Edition), and the Willston. Is this one for a specific room, or more of a gift?

For a living room, our flagship piece is the Annapolis 20-inch Illuminated Antique Floor Globe. It's a large, hand-assembled, made-in-USA heirloom globe with a raised relief antique map that glows when lit, set on a handcrafted hardwood stand — the kind of piece that anchors a room and gets noticed. You'll find it under that exact name in search, ready to add to your cart.

If you'd prefer the classic bright blue-ocean look instead of the warm antique tones, the Statesman 20-inch Illuminated Blue Ocean Floor Globe with Walnut Stand is our top pick in that style.
